
### Mind your Ps and Qs

### Descripcion
In RSA, a small e value can be problematic, but what about N? Can you decrypt this?[values](https://challenge-files.picoctf.net/c_wily_courier/748a8bfc7244df64f48a6ad1d79b5900ee905dd28ebbcd5856652b0e4435393f/values)

c = 15341890103764929939105506004034128738090325640037083301857608662849501626260517

e = 65537

n = 948406957756830799684818171639547165784816468744946013083947881743680617123566349

tn = 948406957756830799684818171639547165784313244233732410034638933881154553401732736

Python:
```
>>> p = 1891771437429478964908181306574287207137
>>> q= 501332739776173570344039681219489434626477
>>> e = 65537
>>> c = 15341890103764929939105506004034128738090325640037083301857608662849501626260517
>>> tn = (p-1) * (q-1)
>>> d = pow(e,-1,tn)
>>> n = p*q
>>> m = pow(c,d,n)
>>> m
310924024341754586049069014240097859710998385184245570453341488382426297925855600
>>> tn
948406957756830799684818171639547165784313244233732410034638933881154553401732736
>>> d
422490213645889729416944115858470474771091523344123437309630951594676399386050433
>>> hex_str = hex(m)[2:]
>>> if len(hex_str) % 2 != 0:
...     hex_str = '0' + hex_str
...
>>> decoded = bytes.fromhex(hex_str).decode()
>>> print(f'\nDecodificado: {decoded}')

}19ea7cd1_do0g_0n_N_11ams{FTCocip
```
